New EDR-Freeze tool uses Windows WER to suspend security software

Dorian Collier · 23rd September 2025

Aegis reported that misuse of Windows Error Reporting can disrupt endpoint protection. Affected organizations should review endpoint health and investigate unexpected loss of security telemetry.

Defensive steps

Monitor endpoint protection availability, investigate unexpected interruptions, and follow your security vendor’s current guidance.
